data.gender_notes: Karamoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'karama' meaning 'generosity, kindness'. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a virtue to be kind to all living beings and to strive for justice and compassion. The name Karamoon carries the meaning “Generosity, Kindness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Karamoon usually hope their child will grow to embody generosity, kindness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages kindness, compassion and generosity towards others.
data.etymology: Karamoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generosity, Kindness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karamoon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: کرامون
in_urdu.meaning: کرامون کا مطلب ہے عطا کرنا، کریم ہونا، سخاوت کرنا

in_hindi.name: करामून
